column1: # Warnings a gate row's console may print (tools/gate/console_judge.py reads this; its classes are listed there).
# Columns, tab separated: a regex the row's label must match entirely (.* for every row), a class (or *),
# a regex the warning line must contain, and why the line is expected there.
# The first block is every row: what an unprovisioned development image says on each boot, by design.
# The second is every gate row but the preset boot rows: the gate's volumes carry only the programs a scenario
# needs (mk/images.mk: "no other scenario gains their tasks"), so the topology's rows for the others are said
# not to be on the volume, and a kernel built with the default console program (TERMD.ELF) finds it missing and
# says once that the recovery console took over. The preset boot rows run the owner's own `make qemu` volume
# Below that each entry belongs to the rows that provoke the line on purpose; a row that only happens to print
# one does not get an entry, it is a finding.
